faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Can foreigners rent apartments in Japan?
faq.a1: Yes. Every apartment on this site accepts foreign residents. You need a residence card (or a visa if applying from overseas) and proof of income or school enrollment.
faq.q2: I don't have a Japanese guarantor. What can I do?
faq.a2: Most apartments use a guarantor company instead of a personal guarantor. Filter by “No guarantor needed” to see them.
faq.a3: Usually the first month's rent, deposit, key money, agency fee, guarantor company fee, fire insurance and key exchange. Each listing shows them line by line with the total.
faq.q4: Can I apply before I arrive in Japan?
faq.a4: Yes, for apartments marked “Apply from overseas”. Viewings can be done by video call.
faq.q5: How long does it take to move in?
faq.a5: Usually 2–4 weeks from application to receiving the keys, depending on screening.
